caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional object with architectural and ornamental features, placed centrally on an off-white background. The object resembles a small, ornate booth or kiosk with a domed roof and decorative elements. The structure is primarily colored in gold, blue, and red hues. The front face of the object features a round window or opening, through which a human figure dressed in brown with a white collar is visible, seated with hands resting on their lap. The roof of the structure is blue with gold outlines, and is adorned at each corner with red floral or ribbon-like decorations. The front panel surrounding the window is gold, with decorative cutouts in the shapes of clubs, diamonds, and spade symbols. The side panel is red and includes an arched lattice window. The base consists of a series of semi-circular brown and gray steps. Beneath the object and slightly to the right, the name "LeRoy Griffith" is written in uppercase letters.
title: Iron Bank
